get_rgb_image: get the RGB image from the LoCoBotCamera simulator sensor observations
get_depth_map: get the depth map from the LoCoBotCamera simulator divided by the depth map factor
get_rgb_depth_segm: get the RGB image, depth map, and semantic segmentation from the LoCoBotCamera sensor observations
get_camera_intrinsics: get the 3x3 intrinsic matrix of the LoCoBotCamera from FOV and resolution config
set_pan_tilt: set the pan and tilt joint angles of the LoCoBotCamera and update sensor state
